items.title: Victor Moore Interview, 1976-03-17
items.q: No, I haven't seen Ralph Burton in thirty years or more.

ctx.x: No, I haven't. Has he talked to you? No, and I'd like to catch up with him, I can tell you that.
In other words, he didn't speak to you about this at all? No, I haven't seen Ralph Burton in thirty years or more. Have you read this book, Vic?

I haven't. It was given to me for Christmas. Uh-huh. And my stepson-in-law said, Vic, he said, you better get this thing out of the house. He said, if your wife ever reads this, you'll never believe it, that it's not true.
